do_not_merge.reason: DOM event mutations vs loopback caller authentication
Unregistered waiter vs completion dropped due queue backpressure
Initial pairing vs refresh rotation distinct credential custody
Tool registration defect vs prompt/tool guidance drift
Attachment sidecar cleanup vs WebUI transcript deletion
Toolchain version enforcement vs exact Gradle binary digest
